## 

## Introduction

Probabilistic Code using the parquet files for the base of the analysis.

## Read in the files

Using the updated BWAM analytics file for prep. Read in the parquet file first and load libraries

```{r message=FALSE}
library(arrow)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(spsurvey)
library(dplyr)


#read in the merged data file from probabilistic_initial_data_workup
#write to RDS to use in other scripts
stream_df_merged<-readRDS(here::here("outputs/Probabilistic_data_workup_2_6_25.rds"))

```

Establish plotting function

```{r}
#plotting function

plot_standard_ests<-function(df,title,ylab,xlab){
  
  plot<-ggplot2::ggplot(df, aes(x=factor(df$Subpopulation), y=df$Estimate.P)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity",aes(fill=df$Subpopulation)) +
  geom_crossbar( aes(x=factor(df$Subpopulation), y=df$Estimate.P, ymin=df$LCB95Pct.P, ymax=df$UCB95Pct.P), colour="grey", alpha=0.5, size=0.5, fill = "grey")+
  # ggpattern::geom_crossbar_pattern( aes(x=factor(chloride_ests$Category), y=chloride_ests$Estimate.P, ymin=chloride_ests$LCB95Pct.P, ymax=chloride_ests$UCB95Pct.P), size = 0.5)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= df$LCB95Pct.P,
                    ymax= df$UCB95Pct.P),
                width=.2,                    # Width of the error bars
                position="identity",
                alpha = 0.5)+
  coord_flip()+ggtitle(label = title)+
  theme(legend.position = "none")

plot+facet_wrap(~Category) + ylab(ylab)+xlab(xlab)

}

#make a list of the available parameters
params<-stream_df_merged |> 
  select(PARAMETER_NAME,UNIT) |> 
  unique()

```

SO we're going to do a continuous analysis with the HAB data, so first we'll subset to the hab parameters AND to the scrapes vs. water columns

```{r}

habs<-stream_df_merged |> 
  dplyr::filter(PARAMETER_NAME %in% c(
    "microcystin",
    "anatoxin_a",
    "periphyton",
    "estimated_diatom_coverage"))

#sample_location is where we have scrape vs. water column

scrapes<-habs |> 
  dplyr::filter(SAMPLE_LOCATION %in% "scrape")

water_column_habs<-habs |> 
  dplyr::filter(SAMPLE_LOCATION %in% "flow_water")


```

alright, now we have it subset to the correct information - we can do a continuous analysis for any of the parameters that we'd like - or a categorial analysis as well

```{r}

#first we'll do continuous for anatoxin in the scrapes

scrapes<-scrapes %>% 
  dplyr::rename(latitude = LATITUDE,
         longitude = LONGITUDE)

ana_scr<-scrapes |> 
  dplyr::filter(PARAMETER_NAME %in% "anatoxin_a") |> 
  filter(adj_wgt >0) |> 
  mutate(result_adj = case_when(is.na(RESULT_VALUE)~0.5 * METHOD_DETECTION_LIMIT,
                                RESULT_VALUE == "NA"~ 0.5 * METHOD_DETECTION_LIMIT,
                                TRUE ~ RESULT_VALUE))


#create sf object
ana_scr.sf <- sf::st_as_sf(ana_scr,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"
)

#run the spsurvey data
cont_ests_ana_adj <- spsurvey::cont_analysis(ana_scr.sf,
  siteID = "SITE_ID",
  vars = "result_adj",
  #subpops = "BASIN.x",
  weight = "adj_wgt" #using the adjusted weights calculatd on 11/22/22 KAR
)

cont_ests_ana_adj$Mean

ggplot(cont_ests_ana_adj$CDF, aes(Value, Estimate.P,colour = Subpopulation)) + 
  geom_line()+
  scale_colour_hue(name="")+
  xlab("Anatoxin_a ug/g")+
  ylab("Estimated Proportion of Stream Miles in NYS")+
  theme_classic()
```

now we can try the categories

```{r}

ana_scr<-scrapes |> 
  dplyr::mutate(tox_cat = case_when(RESULT_VALUE > METHOD_DETECTION_LIMIT ~ "detection",
                             TRUE ~ "non-detect"))

#create sf object
ana_scr.sf <- sf::st_as_sf(ana_scr,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"
)

ana_scr.sf<-ana_scr.sf |> 
  filter(adj_wgt >0)

#run the spsurvey data
standard_ests<-spsurvey::cat_analysis(
  dframe = ana_scr.sf,
  vars = "tox_cat",
  siteID = "SITE_ID",
  weight = "adj_wgt"
)

standard_ests<-standard_ests %>% 
  filter(Category != "Total") |> 
  mutate(Subpopulation = as.numeric(Subpopulation)) |> 
  arrange(Subpopulation)
  
plot_standard_ests(df = standard_ests,title = "Bap Categories",
                   ylab = "% of Total Stream Miles",
                   xlab = "Probabilistic Cycle Year")


pie(standard_ests$Estimate.P, 
    labels = paste(standard_ests$Category,
                   round(standard_ests$Estimate.P, digits = 1), "%", sep = " "),
    )+
title("% of Stream Miles")


```
